# cubepath_dns_zones (Data Source)

Fetches the list of DNS zones.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `zones` (Attributes List) List of DNS zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The domain name.
